The '''Barkhesh Resistance''' was a local rebel force based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barkhesh/Legends|Barkhesh]]. Allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], they offered them supplies in the wake of the loss of [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]]. A [[Rendezvous on Barkhesh|mission]] was effected to transfer the supplies from a [[Rebel Base|supply base]] belonging to the resistance to an Alliance [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]].
